description.value: The West Vancouver Ice Arena is a municipally operated ice rink serving the North Shore community. Located in a residential neighbourhood near Ambleside, it offers public skating and hockey programming. For touring cyclists, it is a publicly accessible recreation facility in a scenic waterfront community.
